mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, creator.username as creator_name, submitter.username as submitter_name, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issu_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at, -- 学生聚合（子查询避免笛卡尔积） (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.recipient_user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.recipient_user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_ids, -- 教师聚合（子查询避免笛卡尔积） (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.instructor_user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.instructor_user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_ids FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON c.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON c.submitter_user_id = submitter.id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON c.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE c.submitter_user_id = #{userId} OR c.created_by = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM certificate_recipient cr WHERE cr.certificate_id = c.id AND cr.recipient_user_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM certificate_instructor ci WHERE ci.certificate_id = c.id AND ci.instructor_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, creator.username as creator_name, submitter.username as submitter_name, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issu_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at, -- 学生聚合 (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.recipient_user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.recipient_user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_ids, -- 教师聚合 (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.instructor_user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.instructor_user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_ids FROM certificate c INNER JOIN certificate_instructor ci ON ci.certificate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON c.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON c.submitter_user_id = submitter.id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON c.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE ci.instructor_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, creator.username as creator_name, submitter.username as submitter_name, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issu_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at, -- 学生聚合 (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.recipient_user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.recipient_user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_ids, -- 教师聚合 (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.instructor_user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.instructor_user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_ids FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON c.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON c.submitter_user_id = submitter.id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON c.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE c.id = #{certId}

-- ===== STUDENT 证书：按 certificate 聚合 ===== SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, creator.username as creator_name, submitter.username as submitter_name, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issu_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at, -- 学生聚合 (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.recipient_user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.recipient_user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_ids, -- 教师聚合（学生证书可能有多教师） (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.instructor_user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.instructor_user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_ids FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON c.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON c.submitter_user_id = submitter.id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON c.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE c.owner_college_id = #{collegeId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT'
UNION ALL
-- ===== INSTRUCTOR 证书：不聚合，每个教师单独一行 ===== SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, creator.username as creator_name, submitter.username as submitter_name, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issu_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at, -- 学生：教师证书无获得者 ARRAY[]::text[] as student_names, ARRAY[]::text[] as student_ids, -- 教师：当前记录关联的教师本人（即证书持有者） ARRAY[holder.real_name]::text[] as teacher_names, ARRAY[holder.teacher_id]::text[] as teacher_ids FROM certificate_instructor ci INNER JOIN certificate c ON ci.certificate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON c.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON c.submitter_user_id = submitter.id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON c.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id -- 关联获取当前证书持有教师的信息 LEFT JOIN sys_user holder ON ci.instructor_user_id = holder.id WHERE c.owner_college_id = #{collegeId} AND c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id
